headline: Coast Guard crews search for six people after small plane crashes in the Gulf of Mexico
label: BREAKING
caption:
Rescue teams are searching for six people after a small plane went down. 🌊

According to the US Coast Guard, emergency crews are actively searching the water for survivors after the aircraft crashed into the Gulf of Mexico.

Authorities have not yet released the identities of those on board or details regarding the flight path and cause of the crash.

Search and rescue operations remain ongoing in the area as teams try to locate the missing aircraft and passengers.
